theme_decision: Dark Theme (Executive Minimalist / Vercel style) - Ultra Premium. Replaces the old green/peach color scheme with deep obsidian, stark white, and subtle silver micro-gradients to achieve a $10,000 look.

headings.strategy: Tracking-tight, crisp, for a modern aesthetic.

body.strategy: High legibility, leading-relaxed for body copy, tight leading for stats/labels.

visual_enhancers.glass_effect: Used ONLY on the sticky top navigation to maintain premium feel. Backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 and 1px border-b border-white/10. Cards will NOT use heavy glass, but rather solid dark surfaces with subtle 1px borders (Bento style).
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Subtle radial gradients (using Tailwind radial-gradient utilities) behind the hero text and under the grid to create depth without looking cheap.
visual_enhancers.bento_grid: The 6 tools must be placed in a responsive Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with tight gaps (gap-6). Each card must have sharp 12px radii with 1px border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.smooth_scrolling: Lenis must be implemented for butter-smooth momentum scrolling.

tool_card.description: Each tool card is a sleek dark surface (bg-[#0a0a0a]) with a 1px border. On hover, the border slightly brightens and a subtle inner shadow or gradient mask reveals itself.
tool_card.structure: Icon at top left, Tool Title, Short Description, Price ($29), and a 'Get it' button opening Gumroad.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black font-medium px-6 py-2 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors duration-200

layouts.page_structure: Single-page application. Fixed glass nav, Hero section with author trust signal, Toolkit Section (Bento Grid of 6 items), Minimal Footer. All fitting tightly to eliminate filler.
layouts.spacing: Generous padding around the hero (py-32), tighter density inside the bento grid (p-8 per card).

motion.interactions: Micro-interactions on cards: hover translates Y by -2px, increases border opacity. Button hover states. Staggered fade-in (framer-motion) for the 6 grid items.

images.description: Portrait for 'Meet Ulista' to establish trust in the Hero section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup @studio-freight/react-lenis (or lenis via typical React wrappers) for smooth scrolling.
Ensure all Gumroad links are anchor tags with appropriate target or script bindings as per standard Gumroad overlay integration.
Build the 6 cards using a CSS Grid (Bento style). Maintain strict 1px borders and high contrast.
Do NOT use any green, peach, or light blue pastels. Stick rigidly to the Black/White/Grey token system.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle micro-gradients.
NEVER use universal transition like 'transition: all'. Apply to specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Include hover states and micro-interactions for all clickable elements.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons for the 6 tools to keep them minimal and sharp.
